'''Trebble''' was an individual who was a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Trebble heard that the [[Tanda Marelle|Tombat]] used an [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]] to map the layout of a manor house by upgrading the droid with a [[Holocamera/Legends|holocamera]] and [[automap]].<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
